The baseline, measured

Reading notes

How the columns relate. Every row is the same episode, so two cells in a column differ only by the recipe. R01 against R00 isolates the input. R01 to R04 is a ladder where each rung adds exactly one change. R05 to R07 is the mismatch ladder, from one broken coupling to all of them. R08 to R10 each add one writing technique. R11 asks for the same things as prohibitions rather than specifications. R12 supplies the score header with no melody.

Where to start. Pick one episode and press Play the ladder. You will hear the old song, then each rung in order. The comparison builds in the ear instead of across sessions.

Three defects, none of which breaks a comparison.
1. Twelve cells originally sent a descriptive section tag to the renderer, which performs tags verbatim. The canonicaliser is fixed and those twelve have been re-rendered, so the corpus is now consistent.
2. R02 and R03 differ by whether a score is supplied at all, which bundles the header together with an authored melody. R12 resolves this: same as R03 but header only, so R02 against R12 measures the header and R12 against R03 measures the melody.
3. The affect lexicon that picks a contrast is crude and word-based. It chooses an opposite well enough and no better.

Songs run about 50 seconds unless the renderer ends early, so a short cell is the model stopping rather than a truncation.

Direction library

Every teaching document the router can choose from. It picks at most one per axis, or declines when none fits. reach is from the library: a not-reachable entry is one the pipeline cannot deliver, kept as information rather than direction.
